Your data

Delete your account

Two taps from the Profile tab. It is a permanent deletion, not a deactivation — and you do not have to email anyone to get it.

Deleting from inside the app

  1. Open SoMi and tap the Profile tab.
  2. Tap the settings icon in the top-right corner.
  3. Tap Delete account.
  4. Read what will be removed, then confirm.

You will be signed out and returned to the welcome screen as soon as it completes.

What gets deleted

Everything tied to your account is removed from our database:

  • Your profile and login
  • All your SoMi flows and check-ins
  • Your journal entries and tags
  • Your streak history

Your authentication record is deleted too, so the account itself no longer exists. This cannot be undone and we cannot restore it for you afterwards. If you want to keep your journal entries, copy them out before you delete.

What is not affected

The exercise videos, voice-overs and music are shared content that belongs to the app, not to your account, so they are unaffected. Historical crash reports and aggregated analytics may persist with our providers for their normal retention periods, but they are not tied to a usable identity once your account is gone. See the Privacy Policy for the detail.

If you cannot sign in

If you have lost access to your account and cannot reach the delete button, email connect@azorean.io from the address you registered with, or tell us the Apple relay address you used with Sign in with Apple. We will verify the request and delete the account within 30 days.

Other data requests

If you would rather have a copy of your data, or want something corrected instead of deleted, write to the same address. Your full set of rights is described in the Privacy Policy.
